name: Government contractors and public-sector suppliers
sector: 7.M Digital economy, social and public sector

problems.words: We find out about tenders too late to prepare properly
quick_ideas: Pick the tender websites and newspapers that matter to you and check them on fixed days
Record every tender you see with its deadline in one list.

workzap_build.text: a tender tracker capturing opportunities, deadlines, go/no-go decision and outcome.

problems.ask_first: How do you hear about new tenders now?
problems.free_stops: Which sources are tracked and how is set out in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note when each tender was first seen and when it closed on recent bids, so you spot how much preparation time you keep losing.
Give one staff member fixed morning checks and one shared tender notebook, so bid preparation starts earlier and stops scattering.

problems.words: Bid documents are assembled from scratch every time
quick_ideas: Gather the company profile, certificates and past contract summaries into one folder
Note the expiry date of each certificate once.

workzap_build.text: a bid document library with expiry alerts on every certificate and a checklist per tender.

problems.ask_first: Which part takes longest each time, the company papers, the pricing or the technical documents?
problems.free_stops: The library structure and checklists are prepared in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count which bid papers were hunted down repeatedly across recent tenders, so you see exactly what slows assembly every time.
Assign one person to keep one master file of reusable bid papers, so each tender starts from gathered material not fresh chasing.

problems.words: Bank guarantees expire and we forget to renew or release them
quick_ideas: List every bank bond and security deposit with its issue, expiry and release dates, so none lapses unseen
Set a reminder well before each date.

workzap_build.text: a guarantee register with issue, expiry and release dates that sends you reminders.

problems.ask_first: Are these bank bonds held at one bank, or spread across several, and who tracks them now?
problems.free_stops: The register and reminder rules go in the solution document.

problems.words: Payments take months and we don't know which invoice is stuck where
quick_ideas: List every submitted invoice with its date and current stage
Update that list after each follow-up visit, so nothing depends on memory.

workzap_build.text: an invoice pipeline board showing where each bill sits and how many days it has waited.

problems.ask_first: Is the payment usually stuck at the department, or at the audit or bank stage?
problems.free_stops: The stages and update routine are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many invoices are waiting at each stage from submission to payment, so the worst blockage point becomes visible.
Give one person one invoice follow-up notebook updated after every call or visit, so stuck bills are easier to chase.

problems.words: Working capital stuck in securities and retention
quick_ideas: Total up once what is held in securities and retention by contract
Note when each is due back, so you can plan around it.

workzap_build.text: a cash-flow view combining receivables, securities and supplier commitments.

problems.ask_first: Is the money mostly tied up in security deposits, or in retention held back on bills?
problems.free_stops: The view's inputs are set out in the solution document; financing questions are for your accountant.

extra_ideas.text: List retention and security amounts by contract and compare them with current supplier pressure, so blocked cash is clearer in day-to-day decisions.
Assign one person to keep one page per contract for held money and expected return timing, so release chasing becomes routine.

problems.words: Inspection rejects deliveries for small paperwork gaps
quick_ideas: Write down the documents inspection asked for on recent deliveries
Check every delivery against that list before it leaves.

workzap_build.text: a delivery and inspection pack per order with challans, photos of goods and signed acceptance scans.

problems.ask_first: Is it usually the same missing paper, or does it differ by department?
problems.free_stops: The pack contents per buyer are prepared in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note the exact paperwork gaps mentioned on recent rejected deliveries, so dispatch checks match what inspection is actually stopping.
Give one dispatcher one paper checklist kept with outgoing delivery papers, so small document misses stop delaying acceptance.

problems.words: Delivery challans and signed receipts get lost
quick_ideas: Scan or photograph every signed challan the day it comes back
File them by contract in one place.

workzap_build.text: phone capture of signed challans filed directly under each contract.

problems.ask_first: Do they get lost at the site, in transit back, or in the office?
problems.free_stops: The capture and filing set-up go in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many signed challans are missing by contract from the last few weeks, so the loss point is easier to pin down.
Give returns from drivers to one person and one shelf for signed receipts, so proof of delivery stops going astray.

problems.words: Manpower contracts — attendance disputes cut our bills
quick_ideas: Keep a daily attendance sheet signed by the client's site supervisor
Reconcile it weekly, not at month-end.

workzap_build.text: a check-in on the phone for deployed staff that would feed monthly billing and payroll.

problems.ask_first: Do the disputes come from one client site, or from most of them?
problems.free_stops: The check-in and billing link are detailed in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare attendance recorded by your team with what was billed back on one recent manpower contract, so billing cuts are easier to trace.
Give one supervisor the daily attendance handover to the office at a fixed time, so billing support arrives before disputes build.

problems.words: Many contracts running; no single view of deadlines
quick_ideas: Put every contract's delivery dates and penalties in one sheet
Review it at a short weekly meeting.

workzap_build.text: a contract register with milestones, inspection status, penalties and retention on one screen.

problems.ask_first: Is it a handful of contracts that slip, or do you lose sight of most of them?
problems.free_stops: The register design goes in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count all contract dates due this week across delivery, inspection and expiry papers, so the busiest pressure points are clear early.
Give one person one wall list of every live contract date reviewed weekly, so deadline clashes are noticed before penalties bite.

problems.words: We don't know true profit after delays, guarantees and penalties
quick_ideas: Work out the real result on one recently closed contract, including penalties and waiting time
Use that to decide which kinds of tender to go for.

workzap_build.text: a contract closure report showing profit after delays, securities and penalties.

problems.ask_first: Which cost surprises you most, the delay, the bank bond charges or the penalties?
problems.free_stops: The costing model is set out in the solution document.

never_say: Anything involving bribes, "speed money", facilitation payments, bid rigging, fake certificates or inflated bills — pi cannot help with that.
Advice on procurement rules, bid challenges, blacklisting or legal recovery — say "talk to a lawyer".
Tax advice on withholding, sales tax or VAT — say "talk to your accountant".
Typical payment times, margins or win rates.
Asking for officials' names, guarantee numbers or bank details.

sample_reply.person: Hum hospitals ko medical consumables supply karte hain. Payment mahino nahi aati aur pata nahi file kahan atki hai. Koi hal?
sample_reply.pi:
Ji haan, shuruaat chhoti si ho sakti hai, aur pehla qadam aasan hai.
Pehle, har jama shuda invoice ki ek list banayein jis mein tareekh aur maujooda marhala likha ho.
Doosra, har follow-up ke baad woh list update karein, taake sab kuch yaadasht par na rahe.
Is ko mazboot karne ke liye Workzap ye de sakta hai: ek board jahan har bill ka marhala aur intezar ke din nazar aayein, saath reminders.
